item.title: Pangolin vs zrok vs sish in 2026: Self-Hosted Tunneled Ingress Without Cloudflare
item.description: Your homelab is behind CGNAT. Your ISP blocks port 443. And you are tired of paying a usage-metered tunnel service that charges per GB and per “reserved domain”. The obvious escape hatch — a Cloudflare Tunnel — is convenient right up to the moment you need TCP streams, arbitrary ports, or a self-hosted control plane you actually own.
